title: Connect to a school
description: A principal connects to an authorized institutional or commercial workspace while retaining access to personal Self, which does not confer principal authority.

intents.title: Accept a school invitation
intents.outcome: Confirm the right school and enter its authorized workspace.

journeys.title: Accept an invitation
journeys.situation: A principal has received a link, QR code or invitation code and needs to confirm which institution and capacity it is for before requesting access.
journeys.outcome: Confirm the right school and enter its authorized workspace.

existingBehavior: Native school invitation input and QR payloads exist; their security and principal end-to-end behavior are not verified.
invariants: A code, link, QR payload, or selected role alone never grants access.
Keep the invitation intent across sign-in and onboarding without leaking its secret.
Do not present a fabricated school or capacity as verified.
openQuestions: How are invitation secrets protected from authenticated enumeration and bound to intended recipients?
Where is claim_invite_code defined and deployed?
How is a confirmed school scope selected after acceptance on each platform?

steps.title: Receive invitation
steps.interaction: Open a trusted link, scan a QR code, or enter a code.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.interaction: Authenticate or create an account and resume the invitation.

steps.title: Review school invitation
steps.interaction: Review server-confirmed school and role before accepting.

steps.title: Invitation unavailable
steps.interaction: Explain the failure and offer retry or contact.

transitions.title: Authenticate
transitions.action: Open the invitation while signed out.
transitions.feedback: Preserve the invitation and ask the user to sign in.

transitions.title: Check invitation
transitions.action: The signed-in user requests invitation details.
transitions.feedback: Show only details verified by the server.

transitions.title: Invitation rejected
transitions.action: The invitation is expired, revoked, invalid, or unavailable.
transitions.feedback: Explain that access was not granted and offer recovery.

scenarios.title: Principal accepts an invitation after sign-in
scenarios.expected: A server-confirmed principal bond selects the intended school.

scenarios.title: Invitation cannot be confirmed
scenarios.expected: No school access is granted and the user can recover.

intents.title: Connect to a school
intents.outcome: Connect to the correct school without losing access to Self.

journeys.title: Connect to a school
journeys.situation: A principal opens Workspace without a confirmed institution and needs a way to connect to the correct school or commercial organization.
journeys.outcome: Connect to the correct school without losing access to Self.

existingBehavior: Personal Self and the existing account-scoped workspace selector already exist.
The principal capability registry models institutional leadership and existing native principal surfaces.
invariants: Principal authority is institutional or commercial, never a personal principal workspace.
Contacting the founder is optional and never grants school authority.
Opening WhatsApp does not establish that a message was sent.
Personal Self and a teacher personal workspace are separate from principal authority.
Preserve existing school, capacity, authorization, data and navigation behavior during integration.
openQuestions: How do commercial tuition institutes map to principal capacity, bonds and Cedar authorization?
Which existing creation, claim and invitation journeys support each institutional type end to end?
How should onboarding transition into an institution without treating a personal scope as principal authority?
Can the existing school creation and invitation paths safely support principal bootstrap on both platforms and recover after partial failure?

steps.title: Resolve school access
steps.interaction: Check authoritative school scope and preserve access to Self.

steps.title: Connect your school
steps.interaction: Choose an available school, invitation, or supported request path.

steps.title: Request status
steps.interaction: Explain that a submitted request is awaiting review.

steps.title: Contact the founder
steps.interaction: Optionally prepare a WhatsApp message with school and contact details; send it in WhatsApp.

steps.title: Access unavailable
steps.interaction: Explain the failure and offer retry or Self.
